# Map Range

Converts a value from one range to another, e.g. height 0–2 m into a fade from 1 to 0.

`lfs.map_range` · Utilities

## How to use

Set From Min and From Max to your source range.\
Set To Min 1 and To Max 0 for a reversed fade.\
Leave Clamp on to keep the result between the output limits.

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value | `Value` | lfs.float | 0 | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Number to convert, in the source range's units. 0 is the default; connect Position or another value. |
| From Min | `From Min` | lfs.float | 0 | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Lower end of the source range, in the units of Value. 0 is the default. |
| From Max | `From Max` | lfs.float | 1 | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Upper end of the source range, in the units of Value. 1 is the default; keep it different from From Min. |
| To Min | `To Min` | lfs.float | 0 | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Result at From Min. 0 is the default; use 1 here and 0 at To Max to reverse a fade. |
| To Max | `To Max` | lfs.float | 1 | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Result at From Max. 1 is the default; use 0 here and 1 at To Min to reverse a fade. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Result | `Result` | lfs.float | — | — | Resulting number, in the units of your calculation. Connect it to a compatible numeric input. |

## Settings

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Clamp | `clamp` | bool | true | — | Keep results within the output range. On by default; off allows values beyond either end. |
